title: The 30 Fact Page
article:
- Flies can hear each other land on a blade of grass

- Fish can taste things not only in their mouths but all over their bodies

- A dragonfly has 30,000 eyes

- Most people who are color blind can't tell the difference between green and red

- Horseflies taste with their feet which are 10,ooo,ooo times more sensitive than human tongues

- Penguins are attracted to the smell of rotten eggs

- Sea stars do not have eyes. Instead, their arms sense light

- British author Ian Fleming, who created the character James Bond was a spy himself during WWII

- The U.S Cia once strapped cameras on pigeons trained to fly over enemy targets

- In the 1970s a spy used a umbrella to shoot a poison filled pellet at an unsuspecting man

- Perry the platypus the secret agent platypus on the Disney show Phineas and Ferb has his own theme song

- There are more tigers in captivity in the US than in the wild throughout the world

- Each species of big cats has a unique coat for camouflage

- The Bengal tiger is India’s national animal

- Tigers can eat more than 80 pounds of meat in one meal. Tthat's like eating 70 tTons of bone steaks

- Nanorobots are atom sized and can crawl but they are made of human DNA

- At Hong Kong's robot kitchens robots greet, seat, and serve customers

- A 1933 U.S. gold double eagle coin sold for more than $7.5 million at auction in 2002

- The largest US bill was a 10,000 dollar bill 45 years ago

- In Norway butter was once accepted as currency

- In 1685 soldiers in Quebec, Canada, were paid in playing cards

- Oscar the Grouch was originally orange

- Darker colored popsicles melt faster than lighter colors ones

- October 30th is national candy corn day in the USA

- Gummy bears were originally called dancing bears

- The human brain is 78% water

- Ancient Greek believed that mint cured hiccups

- Cotton Candy was originally called Fairy Floss

- There are about 700 different Bazooka Joe Comics

- Some candy like Tootsie Rolls were once marketed as health foods
author: Shai Goffer and Daniel Glazer
